items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: Earl played a nice piano. He used to play the nightclubs.

ctx.x: I'm sorry dear. Don't cease the chord.

Very well. Joe was a piano player, played beautifully, but he was a faker. He played a nice touch, nightclub piano player. And a composer. He wrote Don't Leave Me Daddy. And Earl and Claire wrote some of those tunes too, you know. Earl played a nice piano. He used to play the nightclubs.
He wrote the Triangle Jazz Blues. Did you used to ever play that? No.
